name: Social Media Growth Global Reasoning Runtime
principles: Metric-state labels must come from account/context calibration; the runtime defines no universal numeric thresholds.
Raw platform observations do not automatically seed HPC latent constructs.
Operational pattern rules generate hypotheses, not causal conclusions.
Optional HPC reasoning is delegated to the existing canonical HPC reasoner with its own evidence and causal ceilings.
Account-local diagnosis never mutates scientific evidence.
